brief: Hoo! Let’s step off the Reading Road and into Narnia. The Stone Table stands on an open hilltop. Find a hilltop like it, then take a photo for your teacher.
mapday: No headset today? It’s Road Map Day. Read each line from the book and tap who said it. Then finish two sentences about Aslan.
extra: Turn to where the sun comes up. Say what Lucy and Susan saw at sunrise.
step1: You won’t build today. You will find a hilltop like the Stone Table’s. Read the four things to look for. This list is also in VR, in the Canvas tab.
step2: Put on your headset and open the On-Demand app. Click Explore, type today’s map in Filter environments, and click it. Then click Begin Solo.
step3: Walk and teleport to high ground. Find a green, open hilltop where you can see far in every direction.
step4: Stand on your hilltop and say this out loud. This could be the Stone Table hill because… When Aslan came back, Lucy and Susan felt…
step5: Stand back so it all fits. Open your menu: Library, then Camera, then Take photo. Click the Canvas tab, pick this week’s VR assignment, and click Choose from My Files. Pick your photo, click Use this file, then Submit to Canvas. Look for the green Submitted tag. Then press the Meta button and click Quit.
